goal: The alt-text job, the picture index job and the product index job each cost one statement or none on a five-minute run when nothing changed, a picture is given up on after five failed tries, every product saver embeds at once, and product words carry a change marker for step 0.29.
why: Today each of the three jobs walks every store every five minutes: the picture job re-stamps every picture daily (13,414 date-only updates on 468 rows), the alt-text job lists a finished site for ever and retries a failed picture every day without end, and the product hash runs 288 times a day (about 130 measured). After: an idle five-minute run is 1 statement for alt texts, 1 for pictures and 0 for products, media_embeddings takes fewer than 100 updates a day with no content change, and the product hash runs 24 times a day.

migration.notes: Three files, each add-only. Commit 1: generated, one column commerce.media.alt_tries smallint not null default 0 (media is not a hot table). Commit 3: generated, one column commerce.product_translations.text_changed_at timestamptz not null default now() (not a hot table; a constant default, so no table rewrite), and a custom file (drizzle-kit generate --custom --name product_text_changed_rules, then node scripts/prune-snapshots.mjs) with the trigger function and its BEFORE UPDATE trigger on product_translations. CI's release job applies each file after every check passes, then deploys. Never apply one by hand. After each deploy check the advisors and record the version in docs/decisions.md.
